name: Ancestral Knowledge
body:
Through communing with a deceased ancestor, you can replicate another’s skill.

Prerequisite: Wis 13, character level 7th

Benefit: You gain ranks equal to your character level in a single skill. All ranks gained from this feat must be applied to the same skill and that skill’s ranks may never exceed your character level.

Special: This feat can only be taken once. This feat does not grant a new class skill.
